terminal_conventions.capacitor_25: Non-polarized; a/b are arbitrary aliases. Only the unordered pair of net endpoints is asserted.
terminal_conventions.if_transformers: pSupply denotes the factory terminal defined by the component topology ledger as the B+ supply end; the source schematic does not identify winding polarity or turns.
terminal_conventions.tube_symbol: V4:SCREEN_GRID_GLYPH is a visual electrode symbol on the factory drawing and is not a numbered socket pin.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: One #25 lead joins the filtered 95 V supply rail; its other lead is on B−. Alias a is arbitrary.
The opposite #25 lead joins the B− return rail. Alias b is arbitrary.
The supply end of first IF transformer #12 primary reaches the 95 V filtered B+ bus.
The supply end of second IF transformer #14 primary reaches the 95 V filtered B+ bus.
The 50L6 screen-grid glyph joins the filtered B+ rail and #25 bypass branch; RCA basing data identifies the screen grid as socket pin 4.

verified_symbol_connections.basis: The 50L6 screen-grid glyph joins the 95 V filtered bus shared with #25; RCA 50L6-GT manufacturer basing data maps the screen to socket pin 4.

correction_record.reason: The p.38 factory symbols show the 7A8 and 7B7 grid branches on the shared annotated 45 V conductor, not the 95 V filtered B+ bus. The earlier v0.38 glyph labels misidentified those electrodes as screens on B+; manufacturer pin data and the v0.44 source trace establish V1:5 and V2:3 on F_SCREEN_45V.
correction_record.scope_note: This correction does not identify the upstream source or measurement conditions for the 45 V annotation.

V4:4.scope: Manufacturer basing data maps the screen grid to socket pin 4; it does not document Philco receiver wiring.
